Now test beyond the happy path

Real browser actions. Six scenarios. Reproducible findings.

ScenarioTryVerify
1 · Search + editATL → JFK · Jan 22–25 · 2Enter submits; all five values survive editing
2 · Error + recoveryReturn Jan 21 → Jan 25Date error; correct one field; recover
3 · BoundariesJan 22–22 · 9 passengersSame-day and maximum party are valid
4 · Invalid routeATL → ATL → JFKReject same airport; retain inputs
5 · Empty scheduleJFK → SFO · Jan 22–25No flights found; summary + editing work
6 · Mobile390 × 844 · repeat 1 + 2No overflow; controls remain usable

All dates in 2030. Use 2 passengers except scenario 3. Full prompt includes criteria and evidence requirements.

Turn one session into a team habit

1

This week · engineer + reviewer

Use the workflow on one UI change. Bring a finding, a fix, and evidence.

2

Next week · champion + facilitator

Share reviewed prompts and hold office hours. Route access issues to the admin.

3

After two weeks · team lead

Review outcomes and friction. Expand to another journey when the workflow is useful.

OpenAICodex UI testing lab

Measure repeat use, effort, and quality

Proposed measures for the two-week pilot

1

Repeat use

Share of eligible engineers completing a second reviewer-accepted check.

2

Effort

Time to an accepted check, including human review and rework, versus a manual baseline.

3

Quality

Confirmed versus rejected findings, plus issues missed by the check.
